crossRefs.note: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.
For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will…
“The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him,
being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder…
Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

translations.web: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
translations.bsb: A tranquil heart is life to the body, but envy rots the bones.
translations.kjv: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
translations.asv: A tranquil heart is the life of the flesh; But envy is the rottenness of the bones.
